scope: All 137 mapped Chambertin parcels and 33 recorded legal-entity holder identifiers reviewed for Tier 1: commune edges, cadastral named areas and the #461 historical extension. The INAO feature includes Clos de Bèze; geometry and identities are unchanged. One page-image-reviewed application names BN0034. Producer/company research remains Tier 2; no current farmer is verified.

sources.title: Domaine Eugénie application receipt, dossier 2022-217
sources.finding: Page 11 explicitly groups BN34 under GEVREY-CHAMBERTIN. The letter is stamped 15 DEC. 2022; the cover was published 4 April 2023 and the printed act identifier says BFC-2023-12-15-00001. Retain that identifier, but use the stamped letter date. Application/completion date is 24 November 2022; 0.6426 ha is the combined area across both communes and is not assigned to BN34. The receipt expressly does not authorise cultivation.
